obligor_aliases: Rhode Island Health & Educational Building Corporation (issuer for Lifespan)

moodys.citation_text: Rhode Island Health & Educational Building Corp issues Lifespan bonds. Moody's prior rating Baa2 with negative outlook carried into 2023 per Lifespan EMMA disclosure and prior Bond Buyer coverage.

sp.citation_text: Lifespan held investment-grade ratings in 2022; S&P BBB stable then revised to negative during FY2022/2023 weakness per PBN summaries.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch had Lifespan at BBB+ with negative outlook entering 2023; January 2024 PBN coverage describes the outlook revision from negative to stable while affirming BBB+.

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Fitch upgraded outlook from negative to stable, citing adequate liquidity, improving operations (FY2023 operating income $8.6M vs prior $56M loss), and leading market share; expectation of operating EBITDA margin of 6% or better starting FY2024.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Fitch Ratings upgraded Lifespan's outlook from negative to stable. Fitch affirmed Lifespan's issuer default rating at BBB+, and the series 2024 bonds earned a BBB+ rating.

moodys.citation_text: No Moody's rating change confirmed in window; carries Baa2 negative.

sp.citation_text: S&P inferred stable through 2025-03-31; no downgrade reported in window.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch affirmed BBB+ and revised outlook to stable in January 2024.

outcome_class_rationale: Lifespan/Brown University Health saw Fitch outlook revision from negative to stable in Jan 2024 (positive credit event but not a rating change). Moody's remains Baa2 negative (no action found). Conservative classification: AFFIRM_NEGATIVE_OUTLOOK reflects starting negative outlook from multiple agencies in 2022 carrying into much of the window, with one Fitch outlook stabilization. No downgrade or upgrade actions occurred.
